'''Brandon Bales''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM TIE Interceptors]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1762">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-22-pleasonton-2-17-01d1762/ pleasonton-2-17-01], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 22 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-22-pleasonton-2-17-01d1762/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
